proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

addCompetingToken(address,address,addres.notice: Adds a competing token to the FeeAccount contract.

collectFeesAndDistribute(address).notice: Collects fees generated in the token's pool, distributes them among holders and dev, and rewards the caller. The reward in USDC is calculated as collectedUsdcAmount * collectRewardPercent / FEE_SCALE (scale of thousand).dev reward is not immediately transferred, but locked for a period of time (devRewardsCliff) in a lock position NFT. The lock NFT is transferred to the dev, so they can unclock the reward, once the lock expires. If the dev address is a contract, it must implement the IERC721Receiver interface to receive the lock NFT. Otherwise the reward will be distributed to the lock position NFT holders.

emitPoolMigrated(address,address).notice: Emits the PoolMigrated event from a centralized place.

forceDistributeRewards().notice: Owner-only emergency escape hatch, equivalent to the previous ability to call performUpkeep directly as owner. Lets the owner manually trigger distribution if the CRE DON is stuck or unavailable.

setDevRewardPercent(uint16).notice: Sets the percentage of the collected fees that goes to the devs, in basis points (scale of thousand, e.g. 100 = 1%).

setDevRewardsCliff(uint256).notice: Sets the dev rewards (from the pool) cliff in days.

setForwarderAddress(address).notice: Sets the Chainlink CRE KeystoneForwarder address that is authorized to call onReport.

setLiquidityLocker(address).notice: Sets the liquidity locker contract address.

setMaxTokensRewarded(uint16).notice: Sets the maximum number of tokens that can be rewarded.

setSlippage(uint16).notice: Sets the slippage tolerance for swaps, in basis points (scale of thousand and acutal value is calculated as 1000 - value, e.g. value of 800 = 1000 - 800 = 200 => 20% slippage).

setSwapRouter02(address).notice: Sets the Aerodrome Slipstream swap router contract address.
